715060101.text: Didn't you say that theoretically, there wouldn't be any problems?

715060102.text: The Spike wound up causing the dark mud to gush out instead...

715060103.text: Ah, is that how it is... Agh, to think that I did not factor the ground into my calculations. Ah, what an error.

715060104.text: Factor the ground into your calculations?

715060105.text: That's right. Our previous experiments all took place on softer soil.

715060106.text: But within The Chasm, the medium through which the Spike's energy travels is not soil but rock, which has very different properties. This caused a major discrepancy between the earlier calculations and the actual results.

715060107.text: Indeed, theory is not a mere matter of imagination. Instead, it must be grounded and proven in reality.

715060108.text: This proving process seems kinda dangerous, though. Also, why did so much mud come out all at once?

715060109.text: Indeed, this place is quite far from the mining complex, so the mud really shouldn't be flowing all the way here... The situation must be more urgent than we imagined.

715060110.text: Also, the Pursina's Spike has a definite effect on environments affected by the dark mud. This shows that the mud's proliferation is, as I guessed, an issue that stems from the Ley Lines.

715060111.text: This proves the need for experimentation and proof, does it not?

715060112.text: Of course, if I had done the experiment myself, I would have wound up being attacked by the monsters.

715060113.text: Not that I worry about being injured — that would be a small loss compared to any damage that might be done to the Pursina's Spike. How would I answer to our great tutor Firnas or my fellow researchers in the Kshahrewar...

715060114.text: You should pay more attention to your own safety nonetheless.

715060115.text: True. The data we've collected can be used to adjust the results of our calculations. Now, the solutions to these interfering parameters... I believe there are four such methods, though there should be only one that will prove most effective.

715060116.text: #Thank you so much for helping me with this test run, {NICKNAME}. I will make some adjustments to the Pursina's Spike.

715060117.text: Later, it can be moved into the mining complex, where operations can then begin.

715060120.text: Well, no. I had agreed with Khedive to hire some of the local miners here to move it.

715060121.text: But when they heard that my objective was to resolve the issue of the dark mud, they refused any payment.

715060122.text: I've spoken to Khedive and Muning from the Ministry of Civil Affairs, however. The Mora will still go to them as compensation.

715060123.text: Of course, I'll need you to help start the machine up once it reaches its destination.
